rationale.reason: The unpigmented PU coating lacks the HS 5903 visibility/flexibility and plastic-encasement boundary checks. A coating process alone does not prove coated-textile rather than ordinary textile/plastic classification.

reviewed_boundary.scope:
1. Scope and Applicability

This manufacturing profile covers dry roll fabric with a woven continuous-filament PET substrate and one directly applied, unpigmented, non-foamed aqueous aliphatic polyester-PU coating, made from a purchased ready-formulated dispersion, optionally diluted with process water, electrically dried and cooled. The starting fabric is coating-ready, with its previous wet processing completed. Representative product: a declared grade of coated roll fabric for subsequent bag manufacture; this is a production reference, not a guarantee of waterproofness, safety or service life.

The official CPC 3.0 note lists27997 without a detailed process explanation. Classification context does not establish applicability. Solvent-based PU, wet coagulation/DMF, reactive two-component coating, added crosslinker, pigmented or foamed formulations, PVC plastisol, rubber, hot-melt or membrane lamination, coated felt/nonwovens, synthetic leather, tyre cord, medical articles, garments and made-up tents are outside this profile. Fibre manufacture, PET polymerisation, weaving, upstream dyeing/finishing, consumption and end-of-life are separate stages. A materially different route requires reviewed extension, not a claim of whole 27997 coverage. Sources: `unsd-cpc3-notes-2025`; `jrc-textiles-bref-2023`; `covestro-dln-w50`.

PALTEX’s dated 2020 manufacturer article independently describes water-based PU coatings on woven polyester. It supports a historical market example only: the article does not establish this profile’s single-layer formulation, electric dryer, present supplier recipe or numeric performance. Those conditions require actual foreground records. Source: `paltex-pu-woven-2020`.
reviewed_boundary.covered: Declared single-layer aqueous PU directly coated woven continuous-filament PET roll fabric
reviewed_boundary.excluded: Other fibres, nonwoven/felt, PVC, rubber, solvent/wet-coagulation, laminated membranes, foamed/pigmented/crosslinked routes and made-up articles
reviewed_boundary.market_state: Accepted dry composite roll fabric at factory gate; downstream cutting/sewing not included

authored_review_metadata.scope_review: Narrow direct aqueous unpigmented non-foamed single coating on coating-ready woven continuous-filament PET, electric drying and off-site wastewater treatment handover only. No whole-leaf coverage or accepted mapping.

unresolved_flow_identities.reason: Public mesh,fibre,nonwoven and unspecified standard fabric records do not establish coating-ready finished woven continuous-filament PET fabric state.
Direct-read neat polyurethane and water-based adhesive do not establish aqueous aliphatic polyester-PU coating dispersion composition and supply state.
Direct-read waste paint does not establish segregated wet aqueous polyester-PU dispersion composition.

Public waterproof fabric has Area property and unspecified composition/route; measured areal mass could support a real conversion but cannot establish waterborne PU-on-woven-PET product identity. Keep 1 kg Mass reference without forcing UUID.
Generic waste fibre fabric does not specify composite PET/PU composition or segregation state.
PE product film is not a waste identity; no exact directly verified clean PE wrapping-film offcut waste selected.
Direct-read cleaning wastewater specifies discharged-to-water route, incompatible with untreated treatment-handover effluent; preserve the specific waste row.

evidence_limits: Official CPC note gives27997 heading only,not a universal manufacturing route.
JRC2023 supports process typology and formulation-dependent emission assessment; underlying historical examples are not universal/current emission factors.

Current Covestro product page supports aqueous polyester-PU material availability; supplier film-test formulation,solids,temperatures and storage periods are not adopted factory defaults or fabric performance/lifetime.
Actual factory recipe,additives,water,energy,loss,moisture,area-to-mass conversion and net production must be collected.
Scientific review and reference product identity remain unresolved.
PALTEX2020 is a historical independent woven polyester water-based PU market example only;not proof of current recipe,electric dryer or single-layer profile.
